scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in npm/*|yarn/*) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; *) ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.format:check: prettier --check "artifacts/**/*.{ts,tsx}" "lib/**/*.{ts,tsx}" "tests/**/*.{ts,tsx}" "scripts/**/*.{ts,tsx}" "*.mts" && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server exec uv run ruff format --check app tests
scripts.lint: eslint . && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server exec uv run ruff check app tests
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run typecheck && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --filter "./tests" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run test && pnpm --filter @workspace/tests run test
scripts.test:unit: pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run test && pnpm --filter @workspace/tests run test:unit
